content.description:
We are looking for a strategic and analytical Director of Revenue Operations to join our leadership team. In this role, you will lead the planning, forecasting, and reporting for our Post-Sales teams, spanning Onboarding and Customer Success, while managing and mentoring a team of two analysts. You will partner cross-functionally to diagnose bottlenecks, improve onboarding efficiency, and drive operational excellence that supports the overall growth of our organization.

- This position will be hybrid

- Reports to: Vice President of Revenue Operations

- Partners closely with: Vice President of Onboarding & Customer Success

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

- Operational Excellence & Strategy: Establish scalable processes, systems, and operating models across Onboarding, Customer Success, and Customer Education to boost efficiency, retention, and growth.

- Performance Frameworks & Analytics: Build KPIs, reporting dashboards, and forecasting models to track account health, implementation speed, throughput, and capacity targets.

- Customer Journey Optimization: Analyze customer touchpoints, handoffs, and technical workflows to eliminate bottlenecks and accelerate time-to-value.

- Workforce & Capacity Planning: Direct organizational design, headcount models, role definitions, and resource allocation across the post-sale ecosystem.

- Cross-Functional Transformation: Partner with Product, Sales Ops, BI, HR, and Finance to align cross-departmental priorities and execute key change initiatives.

- Tech Stack & Compensation Alignment: Evaluate and implement RevOps technology, AI automation, and team incentive programs that drive productivity and align with business objectives.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO ACCOMPLISH THE JOB

- 10+ years of progressive experience in revenue operations, customer success operations, or a related field, preferably within a SaaS organization

- Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university (MBA preferred)

- Proven track record of developing and executing successful planning, forecasting, and reporting strategies

- Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with executives, senior leaders, analysts, and cross-functional teams

- Experience with performance metrics, reporting, and CRM tools (Salesforce preferred)

- Ability to analyze and diagnose bottlenecks in processes and systems to improve operational efficiency

- Strategic thinker with a hands-on approach to coaching and mentoring

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

WHAT WILL MAKE US LOVE YOU

- Experience building compensation and incentive plans for post-sales teams

- Understanding of or certification in Six Sigma preferred

Employment with Weave is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, conducted in accordance with applicable laws.

At Weave, we use Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to help us work more efficiently and create a smoother candidate experience. AI may assist with things like writing job descriptions, scheduling interviews, or reviewing applications against job-related criteria.
